QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Missing Goods
QuestInfo.0: You have not been able to find any answers in the case of the mysterious robbery, but Maestra Fiametta at the Trading Post has something to say.
QuestInfo.2: Maestra FIametta at the Trading Post said she noticed something strange about the robbery. Although the goods appeared ready to be shipped, they were taken away in a cart rather than delivered straight to a boat. It seemed like a solid clue.
